claim.claim-text: 2. The child stroller frame (100) according to claim 1, wherein the first frame portion (1) includes a handle frame segment (11), a front leg segment (12), and a coupling part (13) that pivotally connects the handle frame segment (11) with the front leg segment (12).

3. The child stroller frame (100) according to claim 2, wherein the child stroller frame (100) is folded either with the handle frame segment (11) and the front leg segment (12) lying at one same side of the second frame portion (2), or with the handle frame segment (11) and the front leg segment (12) respectively lying at two opposite sides of the second frame portion (2).

4. The child stroller frame (100) according to claim 2, wherein the linkage (5) has a first end and a second end, the first end of the linkage (5) is pivotally connected with any of the handle frame segment (11), the front leg segment (12) and the coupling part (13), and the second end of the linkage (5) is pivotally connected with the pivoting part (3).

5. The child stroller frame (100) according to any one of claims 1 to 4, wherein the linkage (5) includes a second bar (512) and a third bar (521), the second bar (512) being respectively connected pivotally with the first bar (511) and the pivoting part (3), and the third bar (521) being respectively connected pivotally with the first bar (511) and the first frame portion (1).

6. The child stroller frame (100) according to claim 5, wherein the first bar portion (5111) of the first bar (511) and the third bar (521) form a substantially straight shape that extends between the first frame portion (1) and the second frame portion (2) when the child stroller frame (100) is in an unfolded state for use.
7. The child stroller frame (100) according to claim 5 or 6, wherein the second bar (512) includes a curved profile with a concavity facing downward.
8. The child stroller frame (100) according to any one of claims 1 to 7, wherein the rear wheel support member (4) includes a transversal axle or a wheel mount.

9. The child stroller frame (100) according to any one of claims 1 to 8, wherein the first bar portion (5111) has an elongate shape with a length greater than the length of the second bar portion (5112).
10. The child stroller frame (100) according to any one of claims 1 to 9, wherein the first bar (511) has a L-shape.
